purpose: Future defensive planning sandbox. Design now — do not fully implement unsupported predictions.
principles: Simulations rearrange known inventory + known intelligence — they do not invent outcomes
Every simulated delta must list assumptions and unknowns
Outputs remain educational guidance objects (rec_*), never auto-execute

questions.prompt: What changes if I patch today?
plannedEffects: Remove or downgrade exposures linked via fixes

questions.prompt: What changes if I disable this software?
plannedEffects: List residual risks from related stack

questions.prompt: What changes if I migrate browsers?
What changes if I replace this firewall?
plannedEffects: Require manual confirmation of rule parity unknowns

expansionPoints: Human review gate before saving simulated inventory as real
